description: This file contains unit tests for socket stream text communication in the Thunder project, utilizing Google Test framework. It defines a test class 'TextConnector' that simulates socket communication and runs a test case 'Core_Socket.StreamText' to verify socket server-client interaction with message exchange.

classes.name: TextConnector
classes.description: A mock socket connector class inheriting from StreamTextType, used for testing socket communication by simulating message receipt and state changes.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming text data, either submitting it if acting as server or storing it for retrieval.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks until data is pending, returning the lock status.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the received data and clears the internal buffer.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Placeholder for sending data, not implemented in test.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events, signals when socket is open.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the static '_done' flag indicating if the server socket is in a done state.
